reviewStatus: pixel-inspected by production agent; not instructor-approved

entries.context: Clear road; dashboard recognition shows 80 while a just-passed temporary roadworks sign showed 50.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove recognition-system state or the temporal act of passing the sign.

entries.context: Right-curb parked car, cyclist approaching from behind, left indicator visible.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove indicator cadence or cyclist speed.

entries.context: Closed practice area, sharp left turn, cone close to right-front passenger-side corner.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove gaze direction or vehicle speed.

entries.context: Car reversing from driveway over sidewalk; small child partly occluded by hedge.
reviewLimits: Exterior view communicates occlusion but cannot reproduce a specific rear-camera field of view.

entries.context: Right passenger door opens toward raised separate cycle path; cyclist approaches from behind.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove the timing of the door movement.

entries.context: Missed motorway exit recedes in right mirror; next opportunity marked 5 km ahead.
reviewLimits: Temporal history is inferred from the mirror composition.

entries.context: Four-lane city road; motorcycle slightly behind in the car's left blind spot.
reviewLimits: Exterior view approximates, but cannot calibrate, a specific car's blind-spot boundary.

entries.context: Long truck positioned left before tight right turn with right indicator visible.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove turn or indicator motion.

entries.context: Night country road; slow car ahead and one distant oncoming motorcycle headlamp.
reviewLimits: A still cannot establish exact speeds or closing distance.

entries.context: Car begins right turn across raised separate cycle path; e-bike approaches from behind.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot prove the e-bike's speed.

entries.context: Ball rolls into residential street between parked cars; child remains unseen.
reviewLimits: The child is intentionally outside the frame, matching the occlusion condition.

entries.context: Close tailgater fills mirror on narrow wet country road.
reviewLimits: The ego car's below-limit speed cannot be independently proven by the photo.

entries.context: Frosty morning; dry approach and shaded bridge deck with thin icy sheen before bend.
reviewLimits: Surface grip cannot be physically tested from a photograph.

entries.context: Hard daytime rain, short visibility and slow traffic.
reviewLimits: The ego car's rear-light state is outside the driver-view frame.

entries.context: Tractor immediately before blind crest on narrow country road.
reviewLimits: The unseen road beyond the crest is intentionally unknowable.

entries.context: School pickup; right-curb parked cars hide sidewalk and parent stands at open door.
reviewLimits: Pickup timing is conveyed through scene cues rather than verifiable clock time.

entries.context: Railway barriers up and lights off; queue beyond leaves no clearance over tracks.
reviewLimits: A still cannot prove that the queue will remain stopped.

entries.context: Green signal while uniformed officer gives clear palm-out stop signal.
reviewLimits: Officer identity and traffic authority are represented visually, not independently authenticated.

entries.context: Green signal; own lane is queued immediately beyond an otherwise clear intersection.
reviewLimits: Static image cannot establish whether the queue is about to move.

entries.context: Car stopped at right-side road mouth with its own right indicator visible; driver face hidden.
reviewLimits: Intent and wheel motion cannot be proven beyond the depicted cues.

entries.context: Stopped at red; ambulance with blue lights behind while pedestrians cross ahead.
reviewLimits: Siren audio cannot be represented in a static image.

entries.context: Fresh night crash; car partly on road and person in ditch, non-graphic.
reviewLimits: Injury severity and freshness cannot be medically or temporally verified from a still.

entries.context: Car exits petrol station across sidewalk and raised cycle path; traffic left and cyclist right.
reviewLimits: A still communicates relative positions but not arrival times.

entries.context: Equal uncontrolled intersection; one car travels right-to-left across the ego path.
reviewLimits: Motion direction is inferred from vehicle pose in the still.

entries.context: Car exits roundabout; pedestrian steps onto exit crossing and cyclist continues around outer track.
reviewLimits: Movement paths and timing are inferred from body and vehicle poses.

entries.context: 80 sign, hard rain, short sight and standing water in wheel tracks.
reviewLimits: A photograph cannot establish safe speed or measured grip.

entries.context: Normal two-lane road; car slightly behind in left lane beside ego in right lane.
reviewLimits: Lane-change intention and relative speed are not measurable in a still.

entries.context: Narrow road; rear-facing van parked on own right side and oncoming car near narrowing.
reviewLimits: The image states geometry without depicting a right-of-way verdict.

entries.context: Rear car already pulled into oncoming lane and is overtaking ego; slower car ahead.
reviewLimits: Overtaking motion is inferred from relative placement.

entries.context: Yield sign and yield teeth face ego at empty intersection.
reviewLimits: The frame cannot establish traffic outside its visible field.

entries.context: One pedestrian steps from right into unsignalized zebra crossing.
reviewLimits: Pedestrian intention is inferred from stepping pose.
